summary: Arxis, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting completion of its acquisition of Omnetics Connector Corporation, a designer of high-reliability connectors for defense, aerospace, and medical applications. The transaction, announced May 29, 2026, closed August 17, 2026, based on an agreed enterprise value of $770 million, subject to customary adjustments. At closing, Arxis issued 13,351,964 shares of Class A common stock to Omnetics shareholders and funded $8.0 million into cash escrow. The stock issuance was exempt under Section 4(a)(2). This strategic acquisition integrates Omnetics into Arxis's Electronic Components segment. What to watch: integration and pro-forma earnings impact.
